name: Process: Run the change-reach read weekly at the leads' review and quarterly at the house review
markdown_description:
P16 and I5, with rows 130 and 131. Every week the leads' review's item 6 reads the change-reach record as counts: changes whose brief date precedes the affected person's check-in date; changes with a period's brief record missing the change line since the version; changes with the team home's version or a language version later than the last brief; the one thing missing from any period's brief record in its week. Each is written as sequence corruption on the entry with the fix on the mechanism (the stack's placement, the brief's change line, the translation's publication, the team home's version step) and never on a person; a lead's repeated part is a load reading on the lead's entry, routed to whoever holds a lead's check-in and until then to the partners' review. The count of changes that reached every period inside their window joins item 1 beside the capture rate. The house review reads the quarter's counts in its scorecard section. Extends `86akh675n` and `86akhpu3q` by reference. High.

Filed by Session 11 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task `86ajgmj7c`. Reasoning lives on the S11 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc `2ky45bmy-17253`.
